title: Canada says it ‘does not report to the US’ after Pentagon criticizes military spending
summary_full: Scathing US document memo supposedly ‘atrophied’ defence capabilities of its northern neighbourCanada is a “sovereign nation” that does not “report” to the United States, the country’s defense minister said after the Pentagon released a scathing memo that criticized the supposedly “atrophied” defence capabilities of its northern neighbour.The document, released on Tuesday, said Canada had “yet to make the hard decisions and tradeoffs” necessary to meet previous defence spending pledges and become a “credible partner in the defense of our shared continent”.
